Feature: domains.assistants.features.creation
  Purpose: Allow a Member to create a usable Assistant.
  Behaviors:
    ID | Conditions | Trigger | Outcome | Produced | Consumed | Failures
    assistant_creation | 1 | statement | direct | assistant_created | none | 1
    created_assistant_visibility | 0 | signal:assistant_created | direct | none | assistant_created | 0
  Rules:
    atomic_failure: WHEN creation fails, THE SYSTEM MUST leave no partial Assistant.
    credentials_not_exposed: Credentials MUST NOT be exposed to the browser.
    customer_ownership: Ownership MUST be enforced for every affected resource.
    entitlement: A Member MUST enable only capabilities available to the Member's Customer.
    ownership: A Member MUST create an Assistant only for the Member's Customer.
  Use cases:
    create_from_scratch: Create and begin using an Assistant. (2 behaviors)
  Related to:
    none
  Coupling: producer features (0): none; consumer features (0): none
